name: @openlance/aios-provider-engine
description: Phase 4 Stage 1 Provider Engine: the Runtime's vendor-neutral operational provider subsystem. It carries out provider registration, capability evaluation, deterministic selection and routing, lifecycle, health, governed invocation behind a required GovernanceClearance, bounded failover, and response normalization, over a technology-neutral Provider abstraction. It consumes the frozen @openlance/aios-providers and @openlance/aios-runtime models and the frozen substrate, recreates none of them, and contains no vendor knowledge (no SDK, no vendor request/response model, no API URL, no auth); concrete adapters are separate later sub-stages (ADR-0035).
